Convert design rules into Neo4j Cypher MERGE + SET statements. Output Cypher only, no JSON, no markdown fences.

CONTEXT (deterministically assembled by /context/assemble -- schema layers, SWRL conventions, and the matched Cypher catalog shape(s) with worked examples):
{"ontograph": {"layer": "Ontograph", "graph_value": "OntoGraph", "node_labels": ["Class", "DatatypeProperty", "ObjectProperty"], "key_properties": {"Class": "iri", "DatatypeProperty": "iri", "ObjectProperty": "iri"}, "display_properties": {"Class": "label", "DatatypeProperty": "SWRL_label", "ObjectProperty": "label"}, "iri_prefixes": {"domain_terms": "ex:"}}, "metagraph": {"layer": "Metagraph", "graph_value": "Metagraph", "node_labels": ["Rule", "Atom", "Var", "Literal", "Builtin"], "relationship_types": ["HAS_BODY", "HAS_HEAD", "REFERS_TO", "ARG"], "key_properties": {"Rule": "Rule_Id", "Atom": "Atom_Id", "Var": "name+project", "Literal": "lex+datatype", "Builtin": "iri"}, "iri_prefixes": {"builtins": "swrlb:"}}, "swrl_conventions": {"violation_inversion": {"flag": true, "statement": "Body atoms fire when the constraint is VIOLATED (inverted logic); the head atom sets the violation DatatypeProperty to true. Example: 'maximum height 75' -> body uses swrlb:greaterThan(?val, 75), NOT swrlb:lessThanOrEqual(?val, 75)."}, "atom_ordering": {"relationship_types": ["HAS_BODY", "HAS_HEAD"], "property": "order", "statement": "Rule->Atom edges via HAS_BODY/HAS_HEAD carry an integer `order` property establishing body/head atom sequence. `order` is a reserved Cypher word and MUST be backtick-quoted: MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1)."}, "argument_rules": {"relationship_type": "ARG", "property": "pos", "statement": "Atom->Var/Literal edges via ARG carry an integer `pos` property establishing argument position. `pos` is a reserved Cypher word and MUST be backtick-quoted: MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity).", "var_merge_keys": ["name", "project"], "var_merge_statement": "Var nodes MERGE on both `name` (?<varName>) and `project` -- omitting `project` from the merge key reintroduces the v2.0 cross-project variable-collision bug (fixed per STATE.md v3.0 Phase 7 decision: 'Var merge key includes project').", "literal_merge_keys": ["lex", "datatype"], "literal_merge_statement": "Literal nodes MERGE on `lex` and `datatype`.", "builtin_merge_key": "iri", "builtin_merge_statement": "Builtin nodes MERGE on `iri` (swrlb:<builtinName>)."}, "naming_quirks": {"Rule_Id": "Rule node key property is `Rule_Id`, not `id`.", "Atom_Id": "Atom node key property is `Atom_Id` (format {Rule_Id}_A{n} for body, {Rule_Id}_H{n} for head), not `id`.", "SWRL_label": "DatatypeProperty display property is `SWRL_label`, not `label` (Class/ObjectProperty use plain `label`).", "SWRL": "Rule's SWRL-expression body property is named `SWRL`, not `text`.", "reserved_relationship_properties": ["order", "pos"]}}, "selected_cypher_shapes": [{"id": "min_limit", "name": "Minimum Limit", "description": "Constraint of the form "minimum X is N" / "at least N" / "no less than N". Mirror of max_limit: body atoms fire when the measured value falls BELOW the limit (violation-inverted) using a swrlb:lessThan Builtin atom against a Literal threshold. Rule_Id format: R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V.", "swrl_pattern": "<CLASS_NAME>(?e) ^ <PROPERTY_NAME>(?e, ?val) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?val, "<LIMIT>"^^xsd:decimal) -> <VIOLATION_PROPERTY>(?e, true)", "cypher_template": "// 1. OntoGraph -- ontology terms
MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>'})
SET C_Main.label = '<CLASS_NAME>', C_Main.project = '<PROJECT>', C_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:integer', DP_Main.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan', B_Lt.project = '<PROJECT>', B_Lt.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>'})
SET DP_V.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', DP_V.range = 'xsd:boolean', DP_V.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_V.graph = 'OntoGraph'

// 2. Metagraph -- rule node
MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V'})
SET r.SWRL = '<SWRL_EXPRESSION>', r.kind = 'violation', r.project = '<PROJECT>', r.graph = 'Metagraph'

// 3. Metagraph -- variables, literals
MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?<ENTITY_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vEntity.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vValue:Var {name: '?<VALUE_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vValue.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litX:Literal {lex: '<LIMIT>', datatype: 'xsd:integer'})
SET litX.project = '<PROJECT>', litX.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litT:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litT.project = '<PROJECT>', litT.graph = 'Metagraph'

// 4. Metagraph -- atom nodes
MERGE (a1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_A1'})
SET a1.type = 'ClassAtom', a1.iri = 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', a1.SWRL_label = '<CLASS_NAME>', a1.project = '<PROJECT>', a1.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a2:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_A2'})
SET a2.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2.iri = 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2.project = '<PROJECT>', a2.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a3:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_A3'})
SET a3.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a3.SWRL_label = 'lessThan', a3.project = '<PROJECT>', a3.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (h1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_H1'})
SET h1.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1.iri = 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', h1.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', h1.project = '<PROJECT>', h1.graph = 'Metagraph'

// 5. Relationships -- rule <-> atoms
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1)

// 6. Relationships -- atoms -> ontology terms
MERGE (a1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
MERGE (h1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_V)

// 7. Relationships -- atoms -> arguments
MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litX)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litT);", "worked_example": "-- "Minimum number of parking spaces is 2" -> R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V, project 'demo-project'

MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:Building'})
SET C_Main.label = 'Building', C_Main.project = 'demo-project', C_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:parkingSpaces'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = 'parkingSpaces', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:integer', DP_Main.project = 'demo-project', DP_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan', B_Lt.project = 'demo-project', B_Lt.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:parkingBelowMin'})
SET DP_V.SWRL_label = 'parkingBelowMin', DP_V.range = 'xsd:boolean', DP_V.project = 'demo-project', DP_V.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V'})
SET r.SWRL = 'Building(?b) ^ parkingSpaces(?b, ?p) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?p, "2"^^xsd:integer) -> parkingBelowMin(?b, true)', r.kind = 'violation', r.project = 'demo-project', r.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?b', project: 'demo-project'})
SET vEntity.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vValue:Var {name: '?p', project: 'demo-project'})
SET vValue.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litX:Literal {lex: '2', datatype: 'xsd:integer'})
SET litX.project = 'demo-project', litX.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litT:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litT.project = 'demo-project', litT.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_A1'})
SET a1.type = 'ClassAtom', a1.iri = 'ex:Building', a1.SWRL_label = 'Building', a1.project = 'demo-project', a1.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a2:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_A2'})
SET a2.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2.iri = 'ex:parkingSpaces', a2.SWRL_label = 'parkingSpaces', a2.project = 'demo-project', a2.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a3:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_A3'})
SET a3.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a3.SWRL_label = 'lessThan', a3.project = 'demo-project', a3.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (h1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_H1'})
SET h1.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1.iri = 'ex:parkingBelowMin', h1.SWRL_label = 'parkingBelowMin', h1.project = 'demo-project', h1.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1)

MERGE (a1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
MERGE (h1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_V)

MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litX)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litT);"}]}

MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1)

MERGE (a1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)

MERGE (a3)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
